$comment: Line-count ceilings enforced by scripts/check-file-size.mjs and by the `file-size` CI job. A file that hits its ceiling must be split before more code is added to it.
$commentDirectories: Directories that are never scanned. Keep this list aligned with the root .gitignore.
$commentIgnoreGlobs: Glob patterns of files that are never checked, in addition to the directory list above.
$commentExemptions: Paths allowed to exceed their ceiling. Each entry needs a reason and an owner, and should be deleted once the file is split. Keep this list empty in the healthy case.
